map.单位电耗多少合理？: What unit electricity consumption is reasonable?
map.常规活性污泥约 0.2–0.4 kWh/m³，提标（脱氮除磷）与再生水会升高。结: Conventional activated sludge about 0.2-0.4 kWh/m3; upgrading (nitrogen/phosphorus removal) and reclaimed water raise it. Results are estimated per public standards and emission factors, for popular science, teaching and emission-reduction reference; for formal accounting follow official guidelines (e.g., GHG Protocol, provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
map.高效曝气、智能加药与水泵变频是主要节能点，可显著降单位电耗。结果按公开标准与环境: Efficient aeration, smart dosing and variable-frequency pumps are the main energy-saving points and can significantly lower unit power use. Results are estimated per public standards and emission factors, for popular science, teaching and emission-reduction reference; for formal accounting follow official guidelines (e.g., GHG Protocol, provincial carbon emission factors) and measured data.
